about: Which Katamari Forever clip Burda's old style plays for each row of OUAK's motion table (OujiAnimationSetting_0000, indexed by the game's motion number). OUAK's code plays a row by Animator.Play(state) with speed = AnimeSpeed x row speed. The Forever clips are the Forever Prince's, retargeted (see burda_rig_spec.json old_style.forever_motions); they are not in this folder, and a mod reads them from the player's own copy of Forever. Glosses are mine.
pairing: Forever slot k is the k-th section of the motion packs and the k-th record of the system file's motion list; the pairing is inferred from the names fitting the clips.

policy.forever_clip: Where a row has a Forever pick, play it, set the state's speed to state_speed_for_forever_pace (Forever's speed / OUAK's row speed), so Forever's pace survives OUAK's multiply.
policy.ouak_fallback: Where a row has no pick, play OUAK's own clip on the old-style rig. 99 of OUAK's 104 clips set the waist's height, at the Prince's 26.345 (OUAK's numbers, centimetres); the old style's waist rests at 33.76 in those numbers (0.3376 m in her FBX). So add about 7.4 to the waist's height on the clips that set it, and leave the other clips alone.
policy.lengths: Each clip keeps its own length. Ten of the controller's twelve transitions leave at a normalised exit time, so a clip of another length only changes when they fire; the other two wait on the isArrive bool.
policy.status: My defaults; nobody has seen them in the game.

basis_meaning.name+pose: the names fit and the pose comparison ranks it first or second
basis_meaning.pose picks one of two: the names fit two clips (two sides or two speeds); the pose comparison picks one
basis_meaning.name: the names fit but the poses differ
basis_meaning.default: my choice where neither settles it
basis_meaning.no Forever clip fits: OUAK's clip plays (cars, emotes Forever lacks, select screen, pulling)
basis_meaning.not requested by code: the game never asks for this row

pose_score: Distance after time warping between OUAK and Forever joint directions (lower is closer); rank among all 160 Forever clips.
loop_note: ouak_state_loops is the OUAK state's loop setting; forever_loops is the Forever record's loop byte (inferred). Rows marked loop_differs play a Forever clip whose looping differs from the state's; check them in game.

rows.note: Every Forever character has its own clip in this slot; Burda takes the Prince's.

The names point the other way: anticlockwise reads as a left turn. The two turns tie on pose; the side comes from the comparison's mirror test, whose left and right agreed with the names on all four rolls and coasts. Check in game.
As row 16, the other way round. Check in game.
The two brakes tie on pose; the side comes from the mirror test, as on rows 16 and 17. Check in game.
As row 20, the other way round. Check in game.

rows.gloss: look up (pose set by the game)

rows.note: My default. The names fit relaxing and sitting down (p2:107); neither matches well on pose. Sitting down ranks first but does not loop, and the rest state loops, so relaxing it is.
This clip and row 67's also move a node whose path resolves on neither the Prince nor Burda (hash 420414169).
The car version keeps OUAK's clip, since Forever has no car.
